stem: Which quotation from the article best explains the ongoing care necessary for the protection of Antarctica?

options.label: A
options.text: These scientists conduct research on a range of subjects, including ecosystems, weather patterns, and the effects of pollution. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: Some of those territories overlapped, and some countries would not recognize the claims made by other nations. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: Since 1959, more countries have joined the agreement, and its objectives have been expanded. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: Scientists and regulators are evaluating the impact such permanent facilities as visitor centers, museums, and hotels would have on the environment. (paragraph 7)
